source.document: Kubernetes v1.38 release team meeting notes (public Google Doc)
source.note: Excerpt of the Updates section, people's names masked; template lines removed.

notes:
* Updates:
      * Exception Requests:
      * Received 6 KEP Readiness Exception Requests; all were approved.
      * Received 6 Enhancement Freeze Exception Requests.
      * The Enhancement Freeze Party ended 4 hours ago.
      * Keeping an eye on the Enhancement Freeze Exception Request.
      * Release Signal (APAC: [participant]/ [participant], EMEA: [participant]/ [participant]):
      * Current Status: Yellow
      * There are currently flaky tests that we are following up on:
      * master-blocking
      * [Flaking Test] E2eNode Suite [It] [sig-node] Probing container should not be restarted with a non-local redirect http liveness probe [NodeConformance]
      * [Flaking Test] E2eNode Suite [It] [sig-node] Probing restartable init container should not be restarted with a non-local redirect http liveness probe [NodeConformance]
      * [Flaking Test] ci-kubernetes-e2e-gce-scale-performance-100.Overall fails with unknown flag: --metadata - [sig-scalability]
      * master-informing
      * [Flaking Test] [sig-node] [DRA] [Feature:DynamicResourceAllocation] Two resource Kubelet Plugins must call NodeUnprepareResources again if it's in progress for one plugin when Kubelet restarts [Serial]
      * [Flaking Test] Kubernetes e2e suite.[It] [sig-node] Pod Allocated Endpoint [FeatureGate:KubeletAllocatedPodsEndpoint] should return all allocated pods with status cleared when listing [Alpha] [Feature:OffByDefault] - a fix is ready for this one - which is already lgtm’ed and awaiting approval
      * [FeatureGate:InPlacePodVerticalScaling] - was not a blocker for the alpha1 cut, a fix is currently being worked on.
      * Updates:
      * V1.38.0-alpha.1 was released yesterday. The v1.38.0-alpha.2 cut is currently
scheduled to be out on October 7th.
      * Last week's branch sync PR has been merged.
      * The weekly branch sync is scheduled for Friday, October 2, and will be handled by [participant].
      * The v1.38.0-alpha.1 Release Notes PR has been created https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/pull/3116 and awaiting review
      * KEP Docs tracking assignments have started for KEPs that have met the Enhancements Freeze requirements. First reminder (R1) outreach is underway, and additional assignments will follow as the tracked KEP list stabilizes.
      * PRs to k/k8s.io, k/org and k/sig-release are now merged
      * Shadow onboarding was held on Wednesday 23rd September
      * I'll be opening the Release Highlights GitHub Discussion and the internal tracking issue this week so we can start collecting input from SIGs as soon as the enhancements list settles.
      * The deadline for Release Highlights is Tuesday 24th November
      * Feature Blog opt-in reach-out starts once the freeze is in effect.
      * Release Lead ([participant]/ [participant]):
      * All of the action items and progress can be found in https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/issues/3087
      * Enhancements freeze is today!
      * Last week was very happening, we had our first release cut + first major deadline (KEP Readiness Freeze), looking forward to another active week with the enhancements freeze
      * Please feel free to review and add your +1s in the exception requests in #sig-release!
